project: ZSim Deployed Config Panel — Drive Disc & Stat Summary
description: 上场角色配置面板剩余工作：驱动盘词条定义表(disc_stat_templates) Schema+种子数据+CRUD、驱动盘6槽位配置编辑表单、面板属性汇总+保存完善+i18n

userStories.title: 驱动盘词条定义 — disc_stat_templates 表 Schema、种子数据与 Rust CRUD
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a disc_stat_templates table to store drive disc main/sub stat definitions per slot, seeded with game data, so the deployed config form can use them for stat dropdowns and value calculation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS disc_stat_templates DDL to db.rs init_db(): id INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, slot INTEGER (1-6 for main, NULL for sub), stat_type TEXT ('main'|'sub'), stat_name TEXT, max_value REAL (main only), per_roll_value REAL (sub only), max_rolls INTEGER DEFAULT 6 (sub only), UNIQUE(slot, stat_type, stat_name)

Add seed_disc_stat_templates() function in deployed.rs that inserts the game data: 1号位 HP 2200, 2号位 ATK 316, 3号位 DEF 184, 4号位 6 options (ATK%/HP%/DEF%/Crit DMG/Crit Rate/Anomaly Proficiency), 5号位 9 options (ATK%/HP%/4 element DMG%/DEF%/PEN Ratio), 6号位 6 options (ATK%/HP%/Anomaly Mastery/DEF%/Impact/Energy Regen), 10 sub stats with per_roll_value and max_rolls=6
Seed uses INSERT OR IGNORE to be idempotent — running init_db multiple times does not duplicate data
Add Rust CRUD functions in deployed.rs: list_disc_stat_templates (filter by slot and/or stat_type), save_disc_stat_template (INSERT OR REPLACE), delete_disc_stat_template
Register 3 Tauri commands in lib.rs: list_disc_stat_templates, save_disc_stat_template, delete_disc_stat_template
Register data_entry::deployed module functions in mod.rs (already exists, just verify)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: 上场角色配置 — 编辑表单：驱动盘 6 槽位配置区（基于词条模板）
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure 6 drive disc slots using stat templates from the database, each with a disc set, main stat (filtered by slot), and up to 4 sub-stats with roll counts and auto-calculated values.
acceptanceCriteria: Drive disc section with 6 vertically stacked collapsible slot panels (Slot 1-6) in the deployed config edit form
Each slot: disc set dropdown (loaded from getDiscSets API), main stat dropdown (options fetched from list_disc_stat_templates filtered by stat_type='main' AND slot=N)
Main stat value auto-filled from template max_value when main stat is selected, displayed as read-only

Each slot: up to 4 sub-stat rows, each with: stat name dropdown (from list_disc_stat_templates stat_type='sub', excluding the selected main stat name), roll count selector (integer 0-6, 0 means inactive), auto-calculated value (= per_roll_value × roll_count, displayed read-only)
Validation rules enforced in real-time: sub-stat name cannot equal main stat name, sub-stat names must be unique within the slot, sum of all sub-stat roll counts ≤ 9
Validation errors shown inline (red border + tooltip on the violating field)
Disc set dropdown shows set name; 2pc/4pc effect hints displayed below the dropdown
Default state: main stat shows placeholder 'Select...', sub-stat rows default to roll count 0 (inactive)
When editing an existing config (configId !== 'new'), all disc fields are populated from saved disc_configs JSON
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Drive disc 6-slot configuration section with disc sets, main/sub stat dropdowns, roll counts, auto-calculated values, and inline validation

userStories.title: 上场角色配置 — 面板属性汇总、保存/加载完整流程与 i18n
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see a real-time summary of my total panel stats across character + wengine + 6 discs, save my complete configuration, and load it later with all fields restored. All text in the deployed config UI should be translated.
acceptanceCriteria: Stat summary panel at bottom of edit form showing summed values for: ATK, HP, DEF, Crit Rate, Crit DMG, PEN Ratio, Anomaly Mastery, Anomaly Proficiency, Energy Regen, Impact
Summary values recalculate reactively whenever any character/wengine/disc field changes (attach input/change listeners)
Calculation formula: sum character base stats + wengine stats (if equipped) + sum of all 6 disc main stat values + sum of all disc sub stat values

Save button serializes complete form state (name, char_id, char_level, char_ascension, cinemas, potentials, wengine_id, wengine_level, wengine_ascension, disc_configs JSON with slot/set_id/main_stat_name/main_stat_value/sub_stats[{name,rolls,value}]) and calls saveDeployedConfig API
On successful save: show success notification, redirect to list page
On save error: show error notification with details
Load existing config: all fields restored including character selection, wengine selection, cinema/potential toggles, all 6 disc slot configurations
'Back to List' button returns to deployed config list page

Add all remaining i18n keys to zh-CN.json, en-US.json, ja-JP.json: disc slot labels (Slot 1-6), main stat, sub stat, roll count, validation messages (duplicate stat, roll sum exceeded, stat same as main), summary section title, summary stat labels
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Stat summary panel with reactive refresh, character/wengine/disc stat summation, save/load complete workflow, 22 i18n keys in 3 locales
